quest.66E88F916B638B3B.quest_desc:
This one might be a bit confusing, there is quite a few &5Creative &eSpellbooks&r! But the one we want is from &d&lAllTheArcanist Gear&r. 

To make this one we need to craft the one from &l&dArs Nouveau&r. That &eSpellbook&r needs an &eArchmage Spellbook&r, &6&lATM Star&r, and a few extra Items. 

It has the same configs as an &eUnobtainium Spellbook&r but has infinite Mana and all Glyphs unlocked! 

All the Spell Power BWAHAHAHAHA!

quest.762581CAE5F5DDC1.quest_desc:
A Magic Mod how fancy! &d&lArs Nouveau&r is the Mod we'll be using to craft together &5Unobtainium&r and &6Allthemodium&r! 

The Enchanting Apparatus is a multiblock which is used for many recipes here currently. Start with an Arcane Core then put the Enchanting Apparatus ontop of it. Next, place Pedestals around the Enchanting Apparatus at the same Y Level. 

Then you can place the Items onto the Pedestals in any order, have Source nearby, and place the Source Gem in the Apparatus it will start! Then you will have crafted your &5Unobtainium&r-&6Allthemodium&r Alloy Ingot!

quest.00F2C4A528873A6B.quest_desc: The &l&bRunic Crucible&r requires &dSource&r to work. Unfortunately, we do not have &dSource Hatches&r to support it. We have another solution, though. Converting that &dSource&r into a liquid using the &dSource Condenser&r. Simply place a &dSource Jar&r with some &dSource&r next to the &dSource Condenser&r, and it will convert it into &dLiquefied Source&r. Now it can be handled by &9Fluid Hatches&r.

quest.06B9D8973E9C6A2C.quest_desc: You might be wondering: Why is an Ars Nouveau item in the Occultism chapter? That's because we have Ars Ocultas, to bridge the two mods. Particularly, Spirits, like our Foliot Crusher, can work in these jars. You can even pipe items into the jars for the spirits to interact with, and they will output it to adjacent inventories (I found the bottom side of the jar to be the most reliable place they output to). If they cannot output to an inventory, they'll output the items into the world.
quest.06B9D8973E9C6A2C.quest_subtitle: Spirits can work in Containment Jars
quest.06B9D8973E9C6A2C.title: Ars Ocultas: Spirit Jars
quest.4ABACE222E647E2C.quest_desc: The Sacrificial Altar is another tool Ars Ocultas offers, this time, focusing on the automation of Sacrifices.\n\nThis Altar goes under your central bowl, and will allow for Sacrifices to be substituted with Source from a nearby Source Jar, if a Containment Jar containing the would-be sacrifice is also nearby.
